_about: Learner model for Mind the Gap. Levels: 0 never heard of it, 1 heard of it, 2 can explain it, 3 has used it. The daily run updates levels, last_covered and next_review from reactions.
baseline_notes: URL-to-page: knows a request goes to a host and the page comes back; no DNS, HTTP, or browser rendering yet.
API key vs password: unsure; thinks an API key holds personal info. Needs: identifies an app/program not a person, used for authentication + billing/rate limits, kept secret like a password.
401: believes it means not found (that's 404). Needs HTTP status code families, 401 unauthorized vs 403 forbidden vs 404.
LLM: thinks it stands for Language Learning Model (it's Large Language Model). No mental model of next-token prediction yet.
queue_note: One main topic per episode, in this order unless reactions or notes say otherwise. Reactions and listener notes always jump the queue. Remove a topic when it becomes an episode's main topic.
queue_later: Then add new topics as needed: caching, databases/indexes, auth tokens/JWT, networking, observability, SaaS integration patterns, data pipelines, prompt engineering, AI evals and risks.
listener_notes: 2026-09-30: Learns best through examples. Wants real-life scenarios/applications, no unnecessary fun facts, one topic drilled per episode, callbacks to earlier topics in later episodes.
